test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

People who belong to the same country.
solution: The correct answer is **option (1)** i.e. **'Natives'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ ** __ • **Natives: **Indigenous people who are originally from a particular place. (स्वदेशी लोग जो मूल रूप से किसी विशेष स्थान के निवासी हैं) • **For example: **The ***natives ***of India have a rich cultural heritage that spans thousands of years. *Therefore, the correct answer is **'Natives'.*** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ ** • **Soldiers: **(सैनिक) Members of the military or armed forces who are trained and equipped for combat. • For example: The ***soldiers ***defended their country with great courage. • **Folks: **(सामान्यतः किसी विशेष क्षेत्र के लोग;) People in general; often used informally to refer to a group of individuals. • For example: The ***folks ***in the small town were known for their friendliness. • **Communists: **(साम्‍यवादी दल का सदस्‍य) Members of a political ideology and movement that seeks to establish a classless society and communal ownership of resources. • For example: The ***communists ***organized rallies to promote workers' rights. 1b2:Tab6, The correct answer is option (4) i.e. **'On'.**
